it has been a pleasure working with you. Thank you for everything I learned from you and for all the good moments along the way.

gifts.title: A gift of rest
gifts.text: May your holidays be full of sleep, good food and zero urgent emails.

gifts.title: Bibingka & puto bumbong
gifts.text: May every Simbang Gabi end with something warm, sweet and shared with the people you love.

gifts.title: A gift of laughter
gifts.text: May 2027 bring fewer meetings, longer lunches and more reasons to laugh at work.

gifts.title: A gift of growth

star.title: Achievement unlocked: Santa's Helper
star.text:
You found every gift under the tree!

Thank you all for the years together. Keep in touch, you know where to find me.

Salamat po, and Merry Christmas!
Jakub

closing.title: The gifts have been delivered 🎁
closing.text:
This little tree has done its job. Thank you for stopping by.

See you in 2027, and Maligayang Pasko!
Jakub
